requirement.title: Mark generated code with [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]
requirement.intent: All MessagePack-generated code is excluded from code coverage so it does not skew coverage numbers.
functional: Every generated formatter, resolver, enum and union type carries [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]
nonFunctional: Generated code behaviour is otherwise unchanged
requirement.issueBody:
#### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
MessagePack generated code is not decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute.

Because it is very hard to write good coverage for generated MessagePack code, it may skew coverage numbers, especially on large projects with a lot of generated code.

#### Describe the solution you'd like
I would like all generated code to be decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute.  I do not feel like a setting is needed, but setting would be fine to have too.

#### Describe alternatives you've considered
There are no alternatives, it is close to impossible to write good coverage for generated code as it covers many edge cases.

#### Additional context

N/A

agent.summary: Added [global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] to every class the MessagePack source generator emits (object/string-key/enum/union formatters, GeneratedMessagePackResolver, composite resolvers) by editing the six .tt templates and their checked-in preprocessed .cs outputs. Regenerated the 222 snapshot resources via the repo's WRITE_EXPECTED mechanism and added ExcludeFromCodeCoverageTests, which runs both generators and asserts the attribute on every generated formatter/resolver class. SourceGenerator.Tests pass 168/168; the execution test projects pass when run with a local -p:MicrosoftCodeAnalysisVersion=4.11.0 override, because the local SDK compiler (4.11) is older than the repo's Roslyn 4.12 reference and otherwise rejects the analyzer (a problem that exists without this change).

decisions.decision: Emit the attribute unconditionally, with no opt-out setting
decisions.why: The issue says a setting is not needed; it keeps the change minimal
decisions.alternatives: An MSBuild/analyzer option to toggle it

decisions.why: Avoids clashes with user namespaces/usings; the type is in netstandard2.0/.NET Framework, so no new dependency
decisions.alternatives: Add a using directive to generated files

decisions.decision: Put the attribute on the resolver partial class declarations (GeneratedMessagePackResolver and composite resolvers), not just on members
decisions.why: The requirement lists resolvers explicitly; a class-level attribute also covers nested helper classes and static initializers
decisions.alternatives: Put it on resolver members/nested classes to avoid CS0579 when users already decorate their own partial declaration

decisions.decision: Edit the preprocessed .cs template outputs by hand, matching the .tt edits
decisions.why: T4 preprocessing doesn't run during dotnet build; the checked-in .cs files are what is compiled

decisions.decision: Regenerate snapshot resources via the WRITE_EXPECTED define, then revert the define
decisions.why: This is the repo's own way to update expected generator output
